docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $395.10 FILED BY SHELDON ELIZABETH AS TO DEFENDANT TOWLES DARRYL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-22-1994 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 07
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT TOWLES DARRYL

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SHELDON ELIZABETH RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT TOWLES DARRYL $395.10 PRINCIPAL, $15.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $410.10, PLAINTIFF WILL NOT ENFORCE THE JUDGMENT UNTIL FEB. 1, 1995 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
